tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run -A serve.ts
tasks.build: deno eval "await Deno.mkdir('dist',{recursive:true})" && deno bundle --platform browser ui/main.tsx -o dist/bundle.js && deno eval "await Promise.all(['index.html','styles.css'].map((file)=>Deno.copyFile('ui/'+file,'dist/'+file)))"
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check ui/main.tsx
tasks.smoke: deno task build && deno run -A tests/smoke.ts
